title: High-total regions
prompt: Using a subquery in the FROM clause that computes total sales per region (as total), return the region and total for regions with total sales greater than 150.
setup_sql: CREATE TABLE sales6 (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, region TEXT, amount REAL); INSERT INTO sales6 VALUES (1,'East',100.0),(2,'East',150.0),(3,'West',200.0),(4,'West',50.0),(5,'North',80.0);
reference_sql: SELECT region, total FROM (SELECT region, SUM(amount) AS total FROM sales6 GROUP BY region) AS region_totals WHERE total > 150;
